name: 95742 · Rncho Cordova, CA
findings: ZIP 95742 (Rncho Cordova) has 42 nonprofit organizations. 10 of them (24%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 8 organizations.
Youth organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (22% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 95742 (Rncho Cordova) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.
